method.geometry: Full evaluated source .blend meshes without decimation
method.containmentTest: Three independent ray-parity votes; every sampled vote must agree; samples within 0.00001 mm of a surface excluded
method.sampling: All connected moving components represented; overlapping triangle vertices/centroids and nearby stationary vertices sampled in both directions, capped at 1152 points/direction
method.penetrationDepth: Nearest-surface distance of a verified interior sample; not a complete maximum penetration computation
method.clearance: Every moving vertex and triangle centroid queried against stationary surface; reported minimum is an upper bound on global triangle-triangle distance
limitations: Five discrete poses are not continuous collision detection.
No observed overlap does not certify full manufacturing clearance or self-intersection freedom.
Surface intersection without strict interior evidence is unresolved contact or penetration, not declared a pass.
Moving labels, springs, switches and sleeves are audited separately, not by this housing script.

findings: No source triangle crossings or strict interior sample evidence was observed in the 540 listed discrete keycap/housing/baseplate/fastener checks.

All nine upper-housing interfaces have witnessed point-to-surface distances below 0.1 mm; therefore a universal 0.1 mm non-contact clearance requirement would fail even though no nominal intersection was found.
Several resting witnesses are predominantly axial and may be intended upper retaining stops. Classify intended stop faces before applying a non-contact tolerance rule.

Left/down key witnesses during pressing include lateral aperture edges. If those are sliding/non-contact faces, provide local relief using the actual manufacturing tolerance budget and re-audit the swept source geometry.
Do not enlarge every aperture indiscriminately: that could remove keycap retention. No source geometry was modified by this audit.
